name: Tresorit
summary: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage and secure file sharing. Protect sensitive business documents with zero-knowledge security and granular access controls.
best_for: businesses and professionals with confidentiality obligations (legal, health, finance) that need end-to-end-encrypted storage, granular sharing controls and compliance features
skip_if: you want cheap bulk storage or deep app integrations (mainstream clouds win), or a personal-grade E2EE like Proton Drive covers your needs at lower cost
honest_knock: You pay the Swiss-E2EE premium (noticeably above mainstream clouds and above Proton Drive per GB) and the encryption trade-offs are inherent: no server-side content search, more deliberate sharing flows, and credential/recovery discipline is on you. For regulated teams that's exactly the deal; for casual storage it's over-engineering.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Professional, 1 user · billed monthly (€36 seen at our 19 Nov 2026 checkout and on the 22 Nov page)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-26 on tresorit.com/pricing/business: the euro yearly rates are unchanged at €28.80, €19.20 and €24; the euro monthly toggle did not load in that reading, so the €36, €24 and €30 monthly prices rest on the 22 November reading and our 19 November checkout at €36.00 for Professional.) (re-verified 2026-11-22 on tresorit.com/pricing/business with both billing toggles: the business prices below are unchanged, €36, €24 and €30 monthly and €28.80, €19.20 and €24 yearly, and the page now also shows an Enterprise card at custom pricing, billed annually. The Personal, Engage and FileSharing prices were last read 2026-11-05.) (re-verified 2026-11-05 on tresorit.com/pricing/business, /personal, /tresorit-engage and /file-sharing in a browser, both billing toggles; Tresorit announced a price increase to partners on 5 November 2026) There are three business plans: Professional for 1 user, Business from 3 users and Business Pro from 5 users. Priced from our location in euros, they run €36, €24 and €30 per user per month on monthly billing, and €28.80, €19.20 and €24 on yearly, which the page badges as 20% off. Before the increase we read €29.99, €20 and €25 monthly and €23.99, €16 and €20 yearly (14 August 2026). Personal runs a permanent free Basic tier plus Lite, Essential and Pro: €5.99, €13.99 and €35.99 a month on monthly billing, €4.79, €11.19 and €28.79 a month on yearly billing. Engage, the data-room product, is priced separately: Engage Professional (1 room manager, 5 contributors) €71 a month and Engage Business (at least 3 room managers, 15 contributors) €177 a month on monthly billing, €63.80 and €162.60 on yearly billing (10% off). FileSharing Business, from 3 users, is €18 per user a month monthly or €14.40 yearly. Our dollar reading of the old plans on 4 August 2026 gave Professional $33.99, Business $24 and Business Pro $30 per user per month; on 26 November 2026 the page served dollars at $40, $29 and $36 monthly and $32, $23.20 and $28.80 yearly. Storage runs 4 TB on Professional, from 6 TB on Business and from 15 TB on Business Pro, with maximum file sizes of 10, 15 and 20 GB. Every plan carries a 14-day trial with no feature limits, but Tresorit requires payment details up front to start it. Enterprise is quote-only.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Tresorit in the 14-day Professional trial that we started with our card. A share link with a password, an open limit, expiry and access logs took about 3 minutes. The price is EUR 36.00 plus 21% VAT, so EUR 43.56 a month in the Netherlands. Cancelling took 3 screens with no discount offer and drops the account to Basic. Account and start: we created the account and started the 14-day Professional trial with his own card. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from about 16:19 to 16:22 CET in Web Access and the Admin Center, on a second try after an expired login. The interface was in English. Nothing was installed, sent or paid. Core action, a folder, an upload and a share link: New folder, Test Folder, Return gave Test Folder created successfully. A CSV file with 5 made-up contacts uploaded at once. Share creates the link straight away; by default Anyone with the link can access and This file can be viewed or downloaded for 30 days. Basic settings: an open count limit (we set 10), expiration 30 days, and a password. Advanced settings: Detailed access logs, Require email address, Disable download and Email notification. After saving: This file can be viewed or downloaded 10 times for 30 days with the password. The link was not sent or opened. Version history showed one version and No more versions. Time to the first result was about 3 minutes in about 12 steps. Admin Center: Policies cover allowed devices, 2-step verification Optional, session control, IP filtering and sharing rules. Reports: detailed reporting (shared links, link activity, external users, devices) is locked behind a reports upgrade button; access logs per link, admin activity and folder activities are already available. Customization lets you add a logo and primary colours; nothing was saved. File Requests, eSign and Engage Rooms were opened but left empty; Engage said You've got 14 days to try it. Plans and trial: Billing shows Plan Professional trial, Billing period monthly, Cost EUR 43.56 / month. Next payment: Professional, 1 user x EUR 36.00 / user / month, 21% VAT (Netherlands) EUR 7.56, due on December 4, 2026, EUR 43.56. Billing history: You don't have invoices yet. Add-ons: Engage in trial mode (then EUR 35.00 / month), Email Encryption (14 days free) and Free Tresorit eSign. Users: You have 0 available seats. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen; it showed a first payment on Dec 3, while Billing says due on December 4, 2026. Cancelling, done the same day: Admin Center, Billing, Modify plan, Cancel subscription. Screen 1, Sorry to see you go, lists what you lose: older file versions, security for files larger than 500MB, eSign access, and Your account will be downgraded to Basic, with Keep current package and Proceed to cancel. Screen 2 asks why, with 11 reasons; we chose I was testing the product. Then an optional feedback box and a second Proceed to cancel. Result: You have successfully cancelled your Professional subscription, a confirmation email has been sent to you. No discount offer, no password and no support contact. Not tested: the desktop and mobile apps, sync and offline use, opening the link as an outside recipient, a real file request, eSign request or Engage room, co-editing and vault recovery. Clean up: Test Folder with the test file and one password-protected share link stay; the subscription is cancelled and the account falls back to Basic. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The checkout named a first payment on Dec 3 while Billing says December 4, 2026. Detailed reports need an upgrade. Cancelling needs two Proceed to cancel clicks.
